intent_en: To illustrate the rising global temperatures that underscore the urgency of making sensible decisions to avoid a future climate crisis.
previous_intent: To illustrate the long-term rise in global temperatures and urge viewers to make sensible decisions now to manage the impending climate crisis.
narration_support: we make decisions now and say okay well this is the cost of trying to manage this thing or we sleepwalk into the crisis the science tells us is coming
chart_support: Line chart showing temperature change in degrees Celsius from 1850 to 2000+, displaying a clear upward trend in global temperatures.
evidence_note: Narration is a fragment discussing the need for decisions to manage a crisis science warns of; the chart anchors this by visualizing the rising temperature data (the 'science') from 1850 onwards.
